title: Gears 'N' Cheers
description: A modpack mainly biased around the Create mod and its addons on Create 6.0
body:
Gears 'N' Cheers is a modpack heavly baised around the Create Mod, the modpack includes automation improvements, weapons, new blocks and mods that will take you through skys water and land via Valkyrien Skies along with other improvements to exploration and visuals. It's also recommended to run this with 8gb of allocated ram, other than that enjoy the pack and have fun!

New Update!! newer versions of this modpack from here forth will include g_mungus's genisis (excl. v1.3.0, made to be more compatable with devices at the lower end such as Steam Deck), now feel free to take your creations to the stars and beyond, enjoy.
